name: The Fabulous Braq
bio:
The clown himself. Braq, or by his stage name, the Fabulous Braq, has left the circus and gone freelance. He entertains with his troupe of performing birds he raises and trains himself.
His departure from the circus was not on good terms, and Braq struggled through a civil suit as a result of his non-compete. Fortunately, he had a crack legal team on his side to get him off scot-free! Now he and his birds are free from the thumb of the man and perform at only the most prestigious street corners and birthday parties.
